rule_source: User-approved governance update: one bounded approval; agent automatically completes mechanical checks. This migration grants no remote or numerical execution authority.

replaces_prospectively.plotting_dependency.future_requirement: Within a future actually authorized execution envelope, automatically observe and record the real producer Matplotlib version, verify compatibility with the already reviewed Agg/PNG/PDF probe, and materialize its metadata before science. Do not substitute local3.9.2, invent a version, or request separate human approval/Code Ready review merely to record an observed auxiliary-library version. A real compatibility/control/numerical change receives only its necessary focused review through the already chosen channel.
replaces_prospectively.execution_template.authority.next_decisi: The only present human decision is whether to authorize the repaired complete scientific execution after the preserved120s scientific first-stop, within the original3600step/data/producer/budget/criteria/stop envelope. If authorized, implementation and in-scope repair, needed focused review in the chosen channel, version/environment/resource checks and commands/RunID/paths/hashes are agent work; do not ask again for each field or commit.
replaces_prospectively.metadata_review_binding: Carry forward genuine signed science/control reviews unchanged. Record exact observed metadata, hashes and invariant comparisons in an automatic consistency receipt; do not forge a reviewer signature or rewrite old review/card hashes. A metadata-only instantiation does not restart Code Ready. Existing exact-card launcher binding must be mechanically adapted/verified inside the future authorized task if needed; this document does not bypass it or claim current launchability.

mechanical_recheck_envelope.applies_only: Before first scientific/model/state work in a future authorized new task; not permission now and not a scientific retry
mechanical_recheck_envelope.accounting: All checks/waits/cleanup consume the same original136hosth/2176coreh and existing shared admission allowance; no budget increase/reset. Plotting admission120s with45s reserve is unchanged and counts inside this300s mechanical cap.
mechanical_recheck_envelope.zero_start_resource_wait: Record known no-start resource unavailability as waiting, not a scientific failure. Recheck only within remaining task authority/cap; exhaustion parks without authorizing a new scientific run.
mechanical_recheck_envelope.explicit_caps: Any human-imposed connection/attempt/first-stop restriction takes precedence; this cap cannot revive consumed authority, mint an evasive RunID, retry unknown/running work or restart a scientifically stopped run.
